decisions.note: Public JP skill data maps ID 120481 to ヤバ技☆ジャグルビート. Preserve the flashy mixed-language title while rendering ヤバ技 compactly as ‘Tuyệt kỹ’.
ID 204511 is verified as Japanese 超然, but the term can imply detached, aloof, or transcendent composure. No repository evidence establishes which Vietnamese nuance should be canonical.
Public JP skill data maps ID 413051 to 激アツ☆ロードマップ. The casual ‘cực cháy’ preserves the intentionally hype/slang tone of 激アツ rather than formalizing it.
Public JP skill data maps ID 101902111 to 超特急入稿！. 入稿 is publishing-specific manuscript submission, so ‘Nộp bản thảo siêu tốc!’ preserves the wordplay accurately.

Locator 47/203691 has no locked/observed Vietnamese mapping, and the exact Japanese source title could not be verified confidently from the checked repository and public references. Defer rather than infer it from Chinese alone.
Public JP skill data maps ID 202861 to ロケットスタート. ‘Xuất phát tên lửa’ preserves the rocket-start metaphor and remains concise as a racing skill name.
